Purpose: The reporting entity. SHH-01 is the only row at go-live; the table exists so consolidation is possible later without restructuring.
Key fields (type · obligation): code (VARCHAR 10, UQ, NOT NULL) · name_ar (NVARCHAR 200, NOT NULL) · name_en (NVARCHAR 200, NOT NULL) · currency (CHAR 3, NOT NULL, default IQD) · decimals_allowed (BIT, default 0) · accounting_start (DATE, NOT NULL) · is_active (BIT)
Notes: Currency and decimal policy live here so that the no-decimals rule is enforced centrally.

Purpose: Accounting years.
Key fields (type · obligation): year_code (VARCHAR 9, NOT NULL) · start_date (DATE) · end_date (DATE) · status (VARCHAR 20: Open/Closed) · closed_by (BIGINT → users) · closed_at (DATETIME2)
Notes: UQ (company_id, year_code).

Purpose: Monthly accounting periods and their lock state.
Key fields (type · obligation): period_code (VARCHAR 7, e.g. 2023-05) · period_no (TINYINT 1-12) · start_date · end_date · status (VARCHAR 20: Open / Soft Close / Final Close / Locked) · soft_closed_by · final_closed_by · reopened_by · reopened_reason (NVARCHAR 500) · locked_at
Notes: UQ (company_id, period_code). Posting is validated against status by VR-09.

Purpose: The approved Chart of Accounts — 145 rows migrated from File 1.
Key fields (type · obligation): account_code (VARCHAR 10, UQ, NOT NULL) · name_ar (NVARCHAR 200, NOT NULL) · name_en (NVARCHAR 200, NOT NULL) · account_type (VARCHAR 20: Asset/Liability/Equity/Revenue/Expense) · account_level (TINYINT, derived) · is_posting (BIT) · is_active (BIT) · normal_balance (CHAR 2: Dr/Cr) · fs_group_code (VARCHAR 10) · is_cash_account (BIT) · is_control_account (BIT) · control_subledger (VARCHAR 30) · requires_counterparty (BIT) · requires_advance_holder (BIT) · requires_contract (BIT)
Notes: The requires_* flags drive VR-06 to VR-08 declaratively instead of in code.

Purpose: Analytical dimension — PRJ-01, PRJ-02, PRJ-03, CORP.
Key fields (type · obligation): project_code (VARCHAR 12, UQ) · name_ar · name_en · project_type (VARCHAR 20: Project/Corporate) · is_active (BIT) · start_date · commercial_operation_date (DATE, NULL until set by parameter)
Notes: commercial_operation_date is NULL by default and may only be set through the parameter workflow (VR-39).

Purpose: Functional cost centres — 19 rows. Never a vendor.
Key fields (type · obligation): cc_code (VARCHAR 15, UQ) · name_ar · name_en · cc_type (VARCHAR 20: Project/SG&A/Operations) · is_active (BIT)

Purpose: Responsibility centres RC-01, RC-02, RC-CORP.
Key fields (type · obligation): rc_code (VARCHAR 15, UQ) · name_ar · name_en · is_active (BIT)
Notes: Derived at migration from the advance account used (see CONF-06).

Purpose: Single master for every external party: contractor, supplier, employee, advance holder, shareholder, government entity, other.
Key fields (type · obligation): cp_code (VARCHAR 20, UQ) · name_ar · name_en · cp_type (VARCHAR 25) · is_contractor (BIT) · is_supplier (BIT) · is_advance_holder (BIT) · is_shareholder (BIT) · is_employee (BIT) · is_government (BIT) · tax_id (VARCHAR 30, NULL) · contact (NVARCHAR 200) · is_active (BIT) · source_alias (NVARCHAR 300)
Notes: source_alias preserves the exact free-text name used in the source workbook so migration remains traceable.

Purpose: Shareholder-specific attributes and the three account links.
Foreign Keys: counterparty_id → counterparties, loan_account_id / current_account_id / capital_account_id → accounts
Key fields (type · obligation): sh_code (VARCHAR 10, UQ) · ownership_pct (DECIMAL 9,6, NULL) · is_approved_financier (BIT)
Notes: ownership_pct is NULL until the shareholding is documented; it must not be assumed.

Purpose: Government concession contract and commercial contracts.
Key fields (type · obligation): contract_no (VARCHAR 50, NULL allowed with status Pending) · contract_type (VARCHAR 30: Concession/Construction/Supply/Service) · signed_date · start_date · end_date · initial_term_years (SMALLINT) · contract_value (DECIMAL 19,0, NULL) · retention_pct (DECIMAL 5,2, NULL) · advance_recovery_pct (DECIMAL 5,2, NULL) · status (VARCHAR 20) · pending_fields (NVARCHAR MAX)
Notes: Unknown contract fields migrate as NULL with status Pending — never invented (File 2 Contract Register).

Purpose: Amendments and change orders.
Key fields (type · obligation): amendment_no · amendment_date · value_change (DECIMAL 19,0) · scope_change (NVARCHAR MAX) · approval_ref

Purpose: Work breakdown under a contract.
Foreign Keys: contract_id → contracts, project_id → projects, cost_center_id → cost_centers
Key fields (type · obligation): wp_code (VARCHAR 30) · name_ar · name_en · budget_value (DECIMAL 19,0, NULL)

Purpose: Bank accounts, cash boxes and project safes, each bound to a GL account.
Foreign Keys: company_id, account_id → accounts, project_id → projects, custodian_id → counterparties
Key fields (type · obligation): ba_code (VARCHAR 20, UQ) · name_ar · name_en · ba_type (VARCHAR 15: Bank/Cash/Safe/Transit) · bank_name (NVARCHAR 200, NULL) · account_number (VARCHAR 50, NULL) · responsible_user_id (BIGINT → users) · is_active (BIT)
Notes: One GL account may back exactly one bank_account row; VR-06 resolves the account from here.

Purpose: Approved funding source values (shareholder, third party, recovery, recycled recovery).
Key fields (type · obligation): fs_code (VARCHAR 20, UQ) · name_ar · name_en · is_shareholder_funding (BIT)

Purpose: The eleven approved funding categories (nine from the COA master list plus the two ledger-only values pending approval).
Key fields (type · obligation): fc_code (VARCHAR 10, UQ) · name_ar · name_en · source_of_value (VARCHAR 40: COA master list / Journal only) · approval_status (VARCHAR 20)

Purpose: One row per source funding reference series entry — AMER-nnn, ABS-nn, ABA-nn, DF-nnn, TAJ-DAR-nn, ACC-JV-….
Key fields (type · obligation): batch_ref (VARCHAR 50, UQ) · series (VARCHAR 20) · batch_date (DATE, NULL) · amount (DECIMAL 19,0) · actual_payment_source (NVARCHAR 200) · source_file (NVARCHAR 200) · source_row (VARCHAR 30) · status (VARCHAR 25: Posted / Held / Review Required / Excluded) · notes (NVARCHAR MAX)
Notes: This is the object every reconciliation in File 1 is performed against (RE-04).

Purpose: One accounting transaction.
Foreign Keys: company_id, period_id → accounting_periods, project_id → projects (header default), created_by/submitted_by/reviewed_by/approved_by/posted_by/reversed_by → users, reversal_of_journal_id → journal_headers (self), linked_journal_id → journal_headers (self)
Key fields (type · obligation): jv_no (VARCHAR 20, UQ per company+year) · pv_no (VARCHAR 20, NULL) · rv_no (VARCHAR 20, NULL) · txn_date (DATE, NULL allowed — see date_status) · posting_date (DATE, NOT NULL) · txn_type_code (VARCHAR 10 → transaction_types) · description_ar (NVARCHAR MAX) · description_en (NVARCHAR MAX) · source_presence (VARCHAR 120) · source_reference (VARCHAR 120) · source_file (NVARCHAR 200) · source_row (VARCHAR 30) · date_status (VARCHAR 40) · doc_status (VARCHAR 15: Complete/Partial/Missing) · recon_status (VARCHAR 60) · status (VARCHAR 15: Draft/Submitted/Reviewed/Approved/Posted/Reversed) · is_migration (BIT) · created_at/submitted_at/reviewed_at/approved_at/posted_at (DATETIME2)
Notes: txn_date is deliberately nullable so that the 311 undated historical entries migrate without a fabricated date (VR-15).

Purpose: One debit or one credit within a transaction.
Foreign Keys: journal_id → journal_headers, account_id → accounts, project_id, cost_center_id, resp_center_id, counterparty_id, advance_holder_id → counterparties, cash_account_id → bank_accounts, contract_id, work_package_id, funding_source_id, funding_batch_id, funding_category_id
Key fields (type · obligation): line_no (INT) · debit (DECIMAL 19,0, default 0) · credit (DECIMAL 19,0, default 0) · chain_step (VARCHAR 80) · capex_opex (VARCHAR 10: CAPEX/OPEX/n-a) · asset_class (VARCHAR 40) · handover_req (VARCHAR 40) · revenue_eligible (BIT, NULL) · recon_status (VARCHAR 60) · source_amount (DECIMAL 19,0, NULL) · amount_difference (DECIMAL 19,0, NULL) · actual_receiver (NVARCHAR 300) · notes (NVARCHAR MAX)
Notes: CHECK (debit >= 0 AND credit >= 0 AND NOT (debit > 0 AND credit > 0) AND (debit + credit) > 0) enforces VR-03.

Purpose: The 39 approved transaction types and the posting rules that belong to them.
Key fields (type · obligation): tt_code (VARCHAR 10, UQ) · name_ar · name_en · requires_board_approval (BIT) · approval_path (VARCHAR 100) · is_active (BIT)

Purpose: Declarative debit/credit account selectors and mandatory dimensions per transaction type.
Key fields (type · obligation): pr_code (VARCHAR 10, UQ) · condition_expr (NVARCHAR 500) · debit_selector (NVARCHAR 500) · credit_selector (NVARCHAR 500) · mandatory_dimensions (NVARCHAR 500) · blocking_rules (VARCHAR 200) · effective_from (DATE) · effective_to (DATE, NULL)
Notes: Effective dating means a rule change never rewrites history.

Purpose: One advance issued to a holder.
Foreign Keys: company_id, counterparty_id (holder) → counterparties, account_id → accounts, project_id, cost_center_id, resp_center_id, issue_journal_id → journal_headers
Key fields (type · obligation): advance_ref (VARCHAR 30, UQ) · purpose (NVARCHAR 500) · amount_issued (DECIMAL 19,0) · issue_date (DATE, NULL) · settlement_deadline (DATE, NULL) · amount_settled (DECIMAL 19,0, computed) · amount_refunded (DECIMAL 19,0, computed) · amount_reclassified (DECIMAL 19,0, computed) · amount_outstanding (DECIMAL 19,0, computed) · status (VARCHAR 20: Open/Partially Settled/Settled/Overdue/Under Review)
Notes: Computed columns are derived from advance_settlements — never stored independently.

Purpose: One settlement, refund or reclassification against an advance.
Foreign Keys: advance_id → advances, journal_id → journal_headers, account_id → accounts
Key fields (type · obligation): settlement_type (VARCHAR 25: CAPEX/OPEX/Fixed Asset/Refund/Reclassification/Sub-advance) · amount (DECIMAL 19,0) · settlement_date (DATE, NULL) · classification (VARCHAR 40) · evidence_status (VARCHAR 25: Evidenced/Pending Evidence/Not Evidenced) · approved_by → users · notes
Notes: classification carries the File 1 audit classifications (A – Valid PRJ-01, B – Valid PRJ-03, C – Personal Receivable, D – Pending Evidence).

Purpose: Evidence attached to a header or a line.
Foreign Keys: journal_id → journal_headers, line_id → journal_lines (NULL), uploaded_by → users
Key fields (type · obligation): doc_type (VARCHAR 40: Invoice/Receipt/PV/RV/Bank Transfer/Contract/Certificate/Approval/Advance Settlement/Other) · doc_ref (VARCHAR 100) · doc_date (DATE, NULL) · file_path (NVARCHAR 500) · file_hash (CHAR 64) · mime_type (VARCHAR 100) · size_bytes (BIGINT) · uploaded_at (DATETIME2)
Notes: file_hash supports duplicate-document detection and tamper evidence.

Purpose: The approval history of any approvable object.
Key fields (type · obligation): object_type (VARCHAR 40: Journal/Account/MasterData/Parameter/Period/Reconciliation) · object_id (BIGINT) · action (VARCHAR 20: Submit/Review/Approve/Reject/Post/Reverse) · action_at (DATETIME2) · comment (NVARCHAR 1000) · approval_ref (VARCHAR 60)
Notes: approval_ref records the board minute reference where a board decision is required.

Purpose: Cash, bank, advance, contractor and control reconciliations.
Foreign Keys: company_id, period_id, bank_account_id (NULL), counterparty_id (NULL), account_id (NULL), prepared_by/reviewed_by/approved_by → users
Key fields (type · obligation): recon_type (VARCHAR 30: Cash/Bank/Advance/Contractor/Supplier/Chain Control/Government Share) · as_at_date (DATE) · book_balance (DECIMAL 19,0, computed from GL) · actual_balance (DECIMAL 19,0, input) · variance (DECIMAL 19,0, computed) · status (VARCHAR 20: Reconciled/Unreconciled/Under Review) · document_id → documents · notes (NVARCHAR MAX) · reconciled_at (DATETIME2)
Notes: book_balance is never writable — VR-57.

Purpose: Duplicate suspicions raised by the duplicate-detection service or carried in from the source.
Foreign Keys: journal_id → journal_headers, matched_journal_id → journal_headers, raised_by/dispositioned_by → users
Key fields (type · obligation): flag_type (VARCHAR 40: Exact Amount+Counterparty / Source Reference / Near Date / Source-carried) · match_reason (NVARCHAR 1000) · value_at_risk (DECIMAL 19,0) · disposition (VARCHAR 30: Confirmed Duplicate/Not a Duplicate/Manual Review Required/Held Unposted) · dispositioned_at (DATETIME2)
Notes: Seeded at migration with the File 1 flags; the 700,595,000 of potential duplicates is carried here.

Purpose: The exception register — classification exceptions, missing documents, open differences, pending evidence.
Foreign Keys: company_id, journal_id (NULL), account_id (NULL), counterparty_id (NULL), raised_by/owner_id/resolved_by → users
Key fields (type · obligation): exception_no (VARCHAR 20, UQ) · category (VARCHAR 40) · raised_date (DATE) · description_ar · description_en · amount (DECIMAL 19,0, NULL) · status (VARCHAR 20: Open/Under Review/Resolved) · resolution (NVARCHAR MAX) · resolved_date (DATE) · source_reference (VARCHAR 120)
Notes: Rows may never be deleted (VR-59).

Purpose: GL account to financial statement line mapping with sign and display order.
Key fields (type · obligation): fs_line_id (VARCHAR 20) · statement (VARCHAR 10: SFP/PL/CF/SCE) · line_name_ar · line_name_en · sign (SMALLINT: +1/-1) · display_order (INT) · subtotal_of (VARCHAR 20, NULL) · effective_from (DATE) · effective_to (DATE, NULL)
Notes: The single source of every financial statement figure (VR-55). Effective dating preserves comparatives.

Purpose: System parameters with effective dating and full history.
Key fields (type · obligation): param_code (VARCHAR 40) · param_value (NVARCHAR 200) · data_type (VARCHAR 20) · effective_from (DATE) · effective_to (DATE, NULL) · approval_ref (VARCHAR 60) · changed_at (DATETIME2)
Notes: Holds the 20% government share, the FX rate, the contract term and the commercial operation date.

Purpose: The 25-task monthly closing checklist per period.
Key fields (type · obligation): task_no (TINYINT) · task_ar · task_en · due_date (DATE) · status (VARCHAR 15: Pending/Completed/Exception) · review_date (DATE) · comments (NVARCHAR 1000)

Purpose: System users.
Key fields (type · obligation): username (VARCHAR 60, UQ) · full_name_ar · full_name_en · email (VARCHAR 120) · password_hash (VARCHAR 255) · mfa_enabled (BIT) · preferred_language (CHAR 2: ar/en) · is_active (BIT) · last_login_at (DATETIME2) · failed_attempts (SMALLINT) · locked_until (DATETIME2)

Purpose: Role definitions.
Key fields (type · obligation): role_code (VARCHAR 20, UQ) · name_ar · name_en · description (NVARCHAR 1000)

Purpose: User to role assignment.
Key fields (type · obligation): assigned_by → users · assigned_at (DATETIME2) · valid_until (DATE, NULL)
Notes: UQ (user_id, role_id).

Purpose: Role to permission grant.
Key fields (type · obligation): permission_code (VARCHAR 40) · scope (VARCHAR 20: All/Own/None/Conditional) · condition_expr (NVARCHAR 300)

Purpose: Immutable record of every change.
Key fields (type · obligation): object_type (VARCHAR 40) · object_id (BIGINT) · action (VARCHAR 30) · field_name (VARCHAR 60, NULL) · old_value (NVARCHAR MAX) · new_value (NVARCHAR MAX) · reason (NVARCHAR 1000) · ip_address (VARCHAR 45) · action_at (DATETIME2, default SYSUTCDATETIME())
Notes: Append-only; no UPDATE or DELETE grant is issued on this table to any application role.

Purpose: Migration reconciliation evidence — one row per control measure.
Key fields (type · obligation): run_ref (VARCHAR 40) · control_name (VARCHAR 120) · source_value (DECIMAL 19,0 or NVARCHAR) · system_value · difference · status (VARCHAR 15: Pass/Fail) · run_at (DATETIME2)
Notes: Go-live acceptance requires every row to read Pass.
